CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[tb_order_search]
    @name varchar(50)  = NULL,
    @amount decimal(10,2)  = NULL,
    @created_at datetime = NULL,
    @note text = NULL
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    SELECT
        id,
        name,
        amount,
        created_at,
        note
    FROM dbo.tb_order
    WHERE
        ((isnull(@name,'') = '') OR (name LIKE '%' + @name + '%')) AND
        ((isnull(@amount,0) = 0) OR (amount = @amount))
END
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[tb_order_add]
    @name varchar(50)  = NULL,
    @amount decimal(10,2)  = NULL,
    @created_at datetime = NULL,
    @note text = NULL
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    INSERT INTO dbo.tb_order
    (
        name,
        amount,
        created_at,
        note
    )

    OUTPUT Inserted.id

    VALUES
    (
        @name,
        @amount,
        @created_at,
        @note
    )

    SELECT SCOPE_IDENTITY() AS id;
   
END
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[tb_order_edit]
    @id int = NULL,
    @name varchar(50)  = NULL,
    @amount decimal(10,2)  = NULL,
    @created_at datetime = NULL,
    @note text = NULL
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    UPDATE dbo.tb_order
    SET
        name = @name,
        amount = @amount,
        created_at = @created_at,
        note = @note
    WHERE id = @id
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[tb_order_delete]
    @id int = NULL
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    UPDATE dbo.tb_order
    SET 
        DeleteBy = @DeleteBy,
        DeleteWhen = GETDATE()
    WHERE id = @id
END
